diagnostics.summary: argument `value` for `List.push` uses `take` but the parameter is `read`.
diagnostics.label: data effect mismatch
causes: A bare argument is `read`; `mut` and `take` must be written explicitly and match the parameter.

fixes.title: Remove `take` from `value`: a `read` parameter takes the bare value.

diagnostics.summary: retaining API `List.push` cannot retain local value `copy`.
diagnostics.label: local value retained

fixes.title: Pass `value` through `manage copy` before retaining it.

diagnostics.label: the left side of `=` is not a place
causes: Assignment targets must be a place: a local, a field, or an index — not a call result or literal.

fixes.title: Declare the target as a `let mut` local, or remove the assignment.

causes: RSScript values must resolve before Rust lowering.

fixes.title: Declare `copy` before using it or pass it as a parameter.
